extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers (including early-career reviewers and trainees), mentors, and editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guides and a rubric to help reviewers (and those who train or mentor them) compose unbiased, constructive peer reviews and to assess the quality of review reports. Includes a bias-reflection exercise, a step-by-step reviewer guide with templates, and a review assessment rubric for scoring and feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bias Reflection Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: A tool meant to help a reviewer assess their own biases and assumptions while reviewing a research manuscript, guiding them through a non-judgmental and self-reflective process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to prompt realization and reminder of personal biases as the first and necessary step to counter them during decision making. Intended to be used by reviewers to increase awareness of potential bias when evaluating manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive, step-by-step framework to guide a reviewer, particularly one with little experience, in the process of reading and evaluating a research manuscript, and writing a peer review report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes resources adapted from the PLOS Peer Review Center and quotes from journal editors collected via conversations or a survey. Contains a printable review template with questions and prompts to guide review composition. Aimed at helping reviewers structure their evaluation and produce constructive reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Assessment Rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: A tool meant for anyone who is evaluating a research manuscript’s review (e.g., a mentor, a peer evaluating a review author, or the reviewer self-evaluating).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rubric comprises 10 statements for which the evaluator is asked to provide a score and a written comment to help improve the review. Freely available for download (Zenodo) under a CC-BY 4.0 license; intended for training, mentorship, and review quality assessment contexts.
